summary: Master structural design and analysis with our specialized ETABS and SAFE training. Gain practical knowledge and enhance your professional expertise today!
lede: Structural design training helps civil and structural engineers turn building drawings and load data into reviewable reinforced-concrete designs. With ETABS and SAFE, learners build and validate building models, define loads and combinations, check concrete members, and design slabs and foundations while interpreting analysis and reinforcement outputs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with building design inputs and need structured, software-based practice in ETABS and SAFE.
prerequisites: Before attending, you need a laptop capable of running desktop structural analysis software, plus installed access to ETABS and SAFE. You should also bring basic structural design references, a calculator, and familiarity with reinforced concrete building components such as slabs, beams, columns, and foundations.
